name: Moat S2 water sensor
notes: Moat S2 leak/temperature sensor: service data under its 128-bit UUID 00001000-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb (Bluetooth-Devices/moat-ble, MIT); a second advertising form is keyed by manufacturer ID 0x1000 in ble_monitor's parser (MIT) — both forms are included; which one current firmware emits is unconfirmed.
